description: This Java class 'Module' serves as a wrapper for the underlying C++ torch::jit::Module, providing methods to load, run, and destroy TorchScript modules within an Android environment.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Java wrapper class for the native torch::jit::Module, providing static load methods and instance methods for module execution and cleanup.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a serialized TorchScript model from disk, optionally with extra files and device specification.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Overload to load a TorchScript model from disk on CPU by default.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Runs the 'forward' method of the module with provided inputs.

methods.name: runMethod
methods.description: Runs a specified method of the module with provided inputs.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Explicitly releases native resources associated with the module.
